newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO LIFT ALL CAPITAL RESTRICTIONS BY END-JULY.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO LIFT ALL CAPITAL RESTRICTIONS BY END-JULY.

text.p: The Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, is going to lift the few remaining restrictions on capital flows by end-July, governor Lucas Papademos told reporters.
The Bank of Greece is expected to let residents open foreign currency accounts in local banks and increase limits on foreign exchange for travelling and studying abroad.
Greece's exchange rate policy would not change in response to fluctuations in the dollar and the pound sterling in world markets, said Papademos.

He was speaking after meeting with Prime Minister Costas Simitis and National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou to discuss the economy and EMU developments. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
